title: The Escarpment of the Coral Triangle
author: Wendell Brightwater
blurb: Orsen Zhou, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
